_source: Vietnam Institute for Building Science and Technology (IBST) station data, via Wikipedia climate tables. Retrieved 2026-08-15.

hcmc._caveat: IBST Tan Son Nhat values could not be extracted directly; widely replicated but unverified in this session.

_findings: Diurnal range is only 6.5-8.3 C. Hanoi's August overnight LOW is 26.1 C at 82.7% humidity. There is no meaningful cooling at night.
Rain is the baseline condition, not an exception: 53% of August days in Hanoi, 65% in HCMC, 37% in Da Nang.
August is near Hanoi's wettest point (309mm, peak of the year) but is one of Da Nang's drier months; Da Nang's season peaks Sep-Nov.
